description: Read news listener launch outcomes and active Node runners

steps.name: news-editorial-diagnostic
steps.script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$base='C:\TTiTTulares'
$log=Join-Path $base 'ttittulares-mobile-trigger.log'
$lines=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Tail 80 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_ -match 'CHAT|EDITORIAL|ERROR|TIMEOUT|LAUNCH' } | Select-Object -Last 15)
$procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Where-Object { [string]$_.CommandLine -match 'Ejecutar[.]js|TT-Editorial-Guard[.]js' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{pid=$_.ProcessId;start=[string]$_.CreationDate} })
$payload=@{state='ok';lines=$lines;procs=$procs}
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+($payload|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 4))
